name: devops-deploy-swarm
description: Production release and deployment swarm managing preflight checks, database migrations, and Vercel/EAS deploys.

pipeline.action: Run full preflight across all workspaces (pnpm preflight)
Verify DIRECT_DATABASE_URL migration safety and drift (pnpm check:db-drift:schema)
Trigger GitHub Environment deploy workflow (gh workflow run deploy.yml)
Perform post-deploy live probe (HTTP health & SSO verification)
